    When should you hire a personal injury lawyer?
    You should hire a personal injury lawyer when you've suffered serious injuries requiring extensive medical treatment, when the insurance company denies or undervalues your claim, when liability is disputed, when multiple parties are involved, or when you're unsure about your claim's value.
